evals.prompt: Evaluate my game idea in idea.txt: is there clone risk, what should the Steam one-liner be, and what should I borrow vs. avoid from other games? Produce a full design brief as well.
evals.expected_output: Completed design brief, identity elements flagged as clone risk, a fantasy-first Steam one-liner, and guidance to borrow design philosophy rather than identity.
expectations: brief.json is validated cleanly via scripts/fantasy_brief.py with no missing or invalid fields
Hollow Knight's identity elements (art, masked bug protagonist, underground world; verbatim shopkeeper and cartographer) are flagged as clone risk
Fantasy statement avoids genre labels ('platformer') and frames who the player gets to be
Recommendation removes identity elements and borrows design philosophy instead while keeping friction solutions (checkpoints, quest loop)
Steam one-liner stands on its own and communicates the 'Shadow Catcher' concept clearly
No fabricated audience size or sales estimates when scale is unspecified
Response is written in English and saved to outputs/response.md
